overview.description: The Corgi U.S. Energy 2x Daily ETF (XLEX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in energy equity. The fund aims to provide 2x leveraged exposure to the daily price movement of the Energy Select Sector SPDR Fund (Ticker: XLE), which provides exposure to US energy stocks. XLEX was launched on Jun 3, 2026 and is issued by Corgi.
